name: task_integrate
description: Acknowledge durable subagent results after incorporating or explicitly rejecting them. Every delivered task_id must be integrated before a normal final answer. Example: {"tasks": [{"task_id": "0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef", "disposition": "accepted", "summary": "Result incorporated; it confirmed the root cause and narrowed the fix."}]}

tasks.description: Delivered subagent results; each item needs task_id, disposition, and a conclusion summary.

task_id.description: The task_id of the delivered result being integrated. Copy it verbatim from the `[task_id=...]` header of a `task` / `task_wait` result (task_status appends the same headers for completed results), or from the `task_id=` / `new_task_id=` field of a `task_spawn` / `task_audit` / `task_retry` result. Required; must be non-empty.

disposition.description: How the parent treats the result: 'accepted' = incorporated into the work, 'rejected' = reviewed but deliberately not used, 'superseded' = replaced by a newer attempt or result.

summary.description: What the parent concluded and how it affects the remaining work.
